CianwoodPokecenter1FLassText:
Did you meet the
#MANIAC?

He's always brag-
ging about his rare #MON.
CianwoodGymGuideText:
The #MON GYM
trainers here are macho bullies.

If I stick around,
they might come after me.

Here's some ad-
vice: the GYM

LEADER uses the
fighting-type.

So you should
confound him with psychic #MON.

Wipe out his #-
MON before they

can use their
physical strength.

And those boulders
in the middle of the GYM?

If you don't move
them correctly,

you won't reach
the GYM LEADER.

If you get stuck,
go outside.
CianwoodGymGuideWinText:
{PLAYER}! You won!
I could tell by looking at you!
CianwoodPokecenter1FUnusedText1:
Don't you get the
urge to show off

your #MON to
friends?

I wish I could
show the #MON I

raised to my pal
in VIOLET.
CianwoodPokecenter1FUnusedText2:
I've been battling
my pal in VIOLET

using a MOBILE
ADAPTER link.

I'm down 5-7
against him. I've gotta crank it up!
CianwoodPokecenter1FSuperNerdText:
I love showing off
the #MON that

I've raised.
Don't you?

I'm going to get
into a bunch of

battles, and show
off my #MON!
